name: @organza/backend
description: Organza Store API — Node + Express + TypeScript + Prisma + PostgreSQL
_comment_prisma_seed: There is deliberately no `prisma.seed` entry. It used to point at the demo seed, which meant `prisma migrate dev` and `prisma migrate reset` could fill a database with fake products and test accounts on their own. Essential data is `npm run bootstrap`; the demo seed is quarantined under prisma/dev/ and has to be asked for by name.
_comment_postinstall: Only `prisma generate` — the generated client is a build artefact of prisma/schema.prisma and nothing else can produce it. The old `build:shared &&` half of this hook (and the pre* hooks that repeated it on dev/build/typecheck/every script) existed only because shared/ was not a real dependency; it is one now, and npm builds it through the shared package's own `prepare` on install.
